title: Globally Optimal Saturation Laws for a Quartic Variance Criterion in Randomized Saturation Designs
banked_reason: Sound abstract quartic-program optimization theory (general V), but the saturation-skew DESIGN claim is degenerate under the run's homogeneous working model: it forces V3=V4=0, so the design variance has no skew dependence (paper-confirmed vs Cai arXiv:2203.09682; Lean-confirmed). Formalization halted at F2/F3 when stopped. Re-raise via heterogeneous (unit-level gamma_i) model + L7/L8 finite-population permutation-moment substrate.
gap_reasons: Abstract quartic-program theory (global dual/KKT certificate, support-at-most-3, stratified threshold, finite-M attainability) is SOUND for general V — not the gap.

DESIGN-SKEW HEADLINE DEGENERATE under the run's own model: HomogeneousLinearShareWorkingModel fixes a single global (beta0,beta1,gamma0,gamma1) for all units, so the Cai skew/kurtosis coefficients V3,V4 (sample variances of unit-level interference params gamma_i) are identically 0. The design variance reduces to V0+V1*Var[pi] with no skew dependence — the saturation-skew DESIGN claim is vacuous in the modeled setting.

proof_attempt_summary: Formalized the abstract quartic-program optimization theory (sound, general V) and built the supporting substrate concurrently, but halted at F2/F3 after a paper-grounded build revealed the run's homogeneous working model forces V3=V4=0 — the design variance carries no skew, so the saturation-skew DESIGN headline is degenerate/vacuous under the model (the abstract theory remains sound). CAD gate discharged (EVT); Winkler partial (atomic case built, extreme=>atomic remains); Cai gate blocked on the model degeneracy. RE-RAISE: heterogenize to Cai's unit-level gamma_i model (eq:dirg:ch3) so V3,V4 are non-degenerate, then build the L7/L8 finite-population permutation-moment substrate to discharge the Cai gate and realize the genuine skew-threshold design result.
tldr: The proposal studies a scoped bridge plus an exact quartic law program. After fixing one homogeneous linear-in-share block-fixed isolated-cluster specialization of the Cai randomized-saturation expansion and naming its resulting coefficient tuple, lem:variance-moment-reduction identifies the o(N^-1)-free leading comparison of every feasible saturation vector with the quartic functional V evaluated at its empirical law, and proves that along regimes M,m -> infinity with N pbar in Z the sharp feasible asymptotic leading surrogate equals min_{nu in N(pbar)} V(nu) via support-at-most-three reduction plus grid-split rounding. The unconditional theorem-level contribution is the quartic-program theory itself: a global dual/KKT certificate, a closed-form threshold for the stratified law delta_pbar, a complete closed-form optimizer over the singleton/two-point class, a support-at-most-three optimizer reduction, finite-M attainability with O(M^(-1)+m^(-1)) rounding implementation, and a special-purpose terminating exact optimizer/certificate procedure that uses elimination/CAD/Thom machinery at exact symbolic or algebraic inputs. No separate parameter-uniform branch-atlas theorem is claimed. The remaining directions are the compact human-readable symbolic atlas and the exact non-leading finite-population variance.
gap: Randomized-saturation papers derive leading variance expressions and optimize inside finite or structured design families, but they do not bridge the Cai continuous-relaxation leading criterion to a full bounded-support quartic law program and then certify its global optimizer.
fill: The project provides the bridge from the standard leading design-variance criterion to V, proves the global dual/KKT certificate, gives the closed-form threshold for the stratified delta_pbar design, proves the complete singleton/two-point optimizer formula, proves support-at-most-three, supplies finite-M attainability and O(M^(-1)+m^(-1)) rounding, and gives a terminating exact algebraic optimizer/certificate procedure.
